_comment: Drafted translation, not yet reviewed by a native Danish speaker. Per the plan discussed earlier: generate with an API/service at build time, then have a native speaker proofread before this ships to real users — especially anything involving money, legal terms, or safety features. Adding a new language: copy this file's key structure exactly, translate every value, then add an entry to SUPPORTED_LANGUAGES in i18n/index.js.
